long_biography.plain_text:
Richard B. Handler helped turn Jefferies from a small equities trading shop into a full-service investment bank. After Drexel Burnham Lambert collapsed, he spent months helping liquidate the firm and manually copied high-yield bondholder lists. Jefferies used that market knowledge to launch bond trading, which seeded its research and investment-banking capabilities.

The 2013 combination with Leucadia placed Handler at the head of a broader public holding company while preserving Jefferies as its operating core. He and longtime colleague Brian Friedman later sold or reduced non-financial holdings and replaced the Leucadia name with Jefferies. Their parent company emerged with a tighter focus on investment banking, capital markets and asset management.
long_biography.html:
Richard B. Handler helped turn Jefferies from a small equities trading shop into a full-service investment bank. After Drexel Burnham Lambert collapsed, he spent months helping liquidate the firm and manually copied high-yield bondholder lists. Jefferies used that market knowledge to launch bond trading, which seeded its research and investment-banking capabilities.

The 2013 combination with Leucadia placed Handler at the head of a broader public holding company while preserving Jefferies as its operating core. He and longtime colleague Brian Friedman later sold or reduced non-financial holdings and replaced the Leucadia name with Jefferies. Their parent company emerged with a tighter focus on investment banking, capital markets and asset management.
